skills.description: Query project knowledge graphs for codebase questions, architecture, and file relationships. Build/update graphs from code, docs, and media; use existing graph first.
Resolve product assumptions in one feature spec; incorporate confirmed decisions and update status. Explicit invocation only.
The Shop architecture/design rules for code, tests, Razor, SCSS, resources, and layer placement. Excludes generic stack questions and DNS/Azure/CI setup.
Add XML documentation to current C# diff through shop-code-documenter. Explicit standalone step; preserves behavior.
Prove user-facing feature acceptance criteria through browser journeys; classify coverage, run, repair, and report in one context. Supersedes {{command:theshop-verify}}.
Implement four layers in one context with plan, scope/build gates, migration, Figma parity, and ledger. Explicit alternative to {{command:theshop-implement}}; no subagents.
Implement feature through Domain, Application, then parallel Infrastructure/Web specialists. Enforce scope/build gates and literal API handoffs.
Create technical implementation plan from feature spec, with AC/task mapping and optional --desc/--figma input. Explicit invocation only.
Resolve technical questions, assumptions, and risks in one feature plan; incorporate decisions and update status. Explicit invocation only.
Review feature diff through independent parallel security/quality agents; unify findings and apply fixes only after approval.
Ship reviewed feature: commit, push, PR, merge, branch cleanup. Explicit invocation; confirm each remote mutation.
Create product-level feature spec and status ledger; resolve blocking questions, log cheap defaults. Accepts --desc. Explicit invocation only.
Start feature branch from updated dev before spec creation. Explicit invocation only.
Write and run feature unit/component tests through separate writer/runner agents. Reconcile manifest and AC coverage. E2E belongs to {{command:theshop-e2e}}.
Write, compile, and run spec-driven feature unit/component tests in one context; produce manifest, report, and ledger. No subagents or E2E.
Deprecated user-facing smoke check: build, run, observe acceptance criteria without source edits. Backend-only features skipped; prefer {{command:theshop-e2e}}.

roles.description: Implement Application use cases/contracts from plan and literal Domain API. Own Application files plus permitted error resources; no tests or other layers.
Add XML docs to public C# APIs in current diff. No behavior changes, refactoring, private-member docs, or inline narrative.
Read-only quality review of current diff against constitution and checklists. Report improvements, polish, strengths; no fixes, tests, or security review.
Read-only security review of current diff: WASM secrets, RLS, authorization, input, PII/payments, auth flows. No fixes, tests, or quality review.
Implement Domain entities/value objects/enums/exceptions from feature plan. Own Domain files only; no tests. Return literal public API.
Implement Infrastructure adapters/repositories from plan and frozen Application interfaces; apply Supabase schema/RLS. Own Infrastructure files; no tests.
Run existing feature tests from manifest; reconcile discovered count and AC results. Report readiness. No code edits or package installation.
Derive unit/component assertions from spec and structure from plan. Write feature-stamped tests and manifest only. No production implementation or E2E.
Implement Web pages/components/stores/resources from plan and Application API; refetch Figma for visual parity. Own Web files; no tests or other layers.
